nodes.label: Indexes Are Rebuildable Caches
nodes.rationale: Deleting the index loses no knowledge because a rebuild re-derives it from truth files by content hash, keeping the store portable and externally editable.

nodes.label: Projection Covers Only Touched Files
nodes.rationale: A write projects only the files it touched and full passes belong to explicit sync, rebuild and crash recovery, because cost growing with store size would make the store unwritable.

nodes.label: Injected Index Under a Hard Byte Budget
nodes.rationale: The injected index carries stable high-weight residents under a byte budget, never query-sensitive picks, so injection stays deterministic and recall handles relevance.
